WITH fielding_by_hand AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN p.bats IS NULL THEN 'Missing'
      WHEN p.bats = '' THEN 'Blank'
      ELSE p.bats
    END as batting_hand,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY CASE 
      WHEN p.bats IS NULL THEN 'Missing'
      WHEN p.bats = '' THEN 'Blank'
      ELSE p.bats
    END
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM fielding_by_hand
)
SELECT 
  fbh.batting_hand,
  fbh.count,
  fbh.count * 1.0 / t.total_count as share,
  fbh.count - t.avg_count as above_average
FROM fielding_by_hand fbh
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE fbh.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY fbh.count DESC;
